correctness.rationale: Matrix units multiply as E_ij P0 E_i′j′=E_ij′ for rank-one sum-functional sandwich P0. For Q vanishing on distinguished rows/columns, star_Q product X(P0+ΣsνQν)Y is associative for all parameters, hence yields simultaneous polynomial integrations. Its infinitesimal Hochschild cocycle F_Q(X,Y)=XQY cannot be a coboundary, since for s∈T left-annihilator, u∈U right-annihilator, (δH)(s,u)=0 but F_Q(s,u)=Q(s,u)e. Nondegenerate Q in square size makes det(P0+tQ)=t^(r−1)det(C), so the generic sandwich algebra is M_r. The augmentation kernel J has J²=U⊗T and J³=0, hence Jacobson radical dim r²−1. Checks include exact finite-field associativity and separation probes; arbitrary field follows algebraically.
